question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word.**

Irreverent
solution:
The correct answer is **"Respectful."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Irreverent"** means lacking respect or showing disrespect. (किसी के प्रति आदर का अनुभव न करने वाला या न दिखने वाला; अनादरपूर्ण)

 
 
• **Example**: *This comedy takes an **irreverent**__ look at the world of politics.*
 
 
 
• **"Respectful"** is the antonym of** "Irreverent."**
 
• **"Respectful" **means showing or feeling respect. (आदरपूर्ण, श्रद्घायुक्त)
 __
 
• **Example**: *The **respectful**__ speaker approached the subject with sensitivity.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 2.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Restoration** means the act of bringing something back to its original condition. (किसी वस्‍तु की मूल दशा में वापसी, मरम्‍मत, जीर्णोद्धार, मूल रूप निरूपण; इसके लिए उठाए गए क़दम)
 
• **Dormant** means inactive or not currently active. (कुछ समय के लिए निष्क्रिय)
 
• **Relevant** means closely connected or appropriate to the matter at hand. (प्रासंगिक, संबद्घ (विचार किए जा रहे विषय या जो हो रहा है उससे संबद्घ))
